comparison.objective: Strike a cue ball so a red ball enters a goal while respecting a reach line; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool pickup, aimed impulsive striking, and indirect ball control versus recessed-tool alignment, controlled collar rotation, counterholding, and bounded tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Red ball reaches the goal without hand/stick line fouls or pushing shortcuts; geometric tolerances are not stated. Candidate requires two repeatable safe impacts within explicit operating limits.
comparison.reason: Although both involve impact physics, cue striking tests impulse direction and indirect aiming, not adjustment and retention of an impact-absorbing mechanism.
